typography.heading_strategy: Headings MUST be uppercase, bold to black weight, with tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Used for event titles, section headers, and call-to-actions.
typography.body_strategy: Clean, highly legible sans-serif for dates, descriptions, and pricing. Slight tracking increase for legibility on dark backgrounds.
typography.font_imports: Ensure Oswald and Inter are imported from Google Fonts.

anti_patterns: NO glassmorphism or transparent backgrounds in the header/nav.

layouts.header: Two-tier navigation: Top bar is SOLID RED (#e10600) with white text. Sub-navigation is SOLID DARK CHARCOAL (#15151e). NO transparency.
layouts.hero: Edge-to-edge full width layout. Large imagery with a heavy gradient overlay to ensure text legibility. Action-oriented.
layouts.cards: Strictly sharp corners (rounded-none). Full-width image cards for events with dark gradient overlays at the bottom for text. Use dense, high-contrast bento style layouts where applicable.
layouts.spacing: Generous vertical spacing between sections (py-16 or py-24). Tight, utilitarian spacing within event lists (p-4) to maximize data density.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none). Primary buttons use bg-[#e10600] text-white with hover:bg-red-700. Text is uppercase, bold, and uses tracking-wider.
components.badges: Status badges (e.g., 'Sehr beliebt: hohe Nachfrage', 'Selling Fast') use bg-[#facc15] text-black, bold, uppercase, small text (text-xs), with sharp edges.
components.trust_signals: Crucial element: Trustpilot-style rating blocks. Use 5 stars in green (#00b67a), '4.4/5' text rating, and 'Excellent' badges prominently in the hero and footer.
components.event_list: Clean list format. Include country flags next to event names. Use distinct 'FILTERS' buttons. Include arrow indicators (chevron-right) for clear navigation.
components.categories: Full-width image cards with bold text overlays for 'HOSPITALITY', 'EXPERIENCES', etc.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid borders (border-white/10) to separate dark sections. No soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.overlays: bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/80 to-transparent is MANDATORY over card images to maintain text contrast.
visual_enhancers.textures: Keep it clean and solid. The 'Performance Pro' archetype relies on extreme contrast rather than noise/grain.

motion.strategy: Minimalist, snappy, athletic. No slow, floaty animations.
motion.hover_states: Quick transitions (duration-150). Translate-y-[-2px] with a crisp shadow, or a solid border color change.

images.description: F1 race cars speeding around a track
Cars driving down a race track
Crowded stadium with fans holding banners

media.icons: Use lucide-react for standard icons. For flags, use a reliable SVG approach or a specialized flag icon package if available, else mock with SVGs.

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT RULE: Absolutely no rounded corners anywhere. Use `rounded-none` for all buttons, cards, badges, and containers.
STRICT RULE: No glassmorphism. Headers and backgrounds must be solid colors (#e10600 for header, #15151e for body).
All Headings must use the Oswald font (font-oswald), uppercase, and tight tracking.
Implement a Trustpilot-like review block in the hero and footer sections.
Create a detailed event listing page with 'Day selector' cards (e.g., 3 days, 2 days, 1 day) and a 'FILTERS' button.
Use high-contrast text. Any text over images MUST have a heavy dark gradient behind it.
Ensure the application works perfectly on mobile (Mobile-first design).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
Ensure dark colors are used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT soft shadows.
Do NOT center align the app container.
Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms (do not use transition-all).
Provide the UI/UX in .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx (as per constraints).
